name: HomeboxLabel
description: External label service for Homebox that generates 4 x 6 inch location labels while preserving compact item labels and QR-code links back to Homebox.

ports.name: Service Port
ports.description: HTTP port Homebox uses to access HomeboxLabel.

variables.name: Homebox Public Base URL
variables.description: Public base URL of your Homebox instance, for example https://homebox.example.com. Used to convert relative Homebox paths into complete QR-code URLs.
